resources.string: "Choose receiving and sending SIMs to forward new SMS to a phone number."
"Tests use saved settings, even when automatic forwarding is disabled."
"SMS and phone permissions are needed to receive, identify, and send with the selected SIM."
"These permissions are required to receive new SMS, identify SIMs, and send SMS. You may leave forwarding disabled."

"New SMS can arrive while the screen is locked or the app is closed. Unlock once after restarting. Reopen the app after force stopping it. Phone battery and background management settings may restrict operation."

"Carrier charges apply. Up to 10 parts per message and 30 messages per hour including tests. Failures are not retried automatically. Messages with forwarding markers are skipped to reduce loops. Never set a local SIM as the destination or create reciprocal forwarding rules."
"Keeps up to 50 status records without SMS content. Sent and delivered are different; delivery reports require carrier support."
"No SIM available. Check permissions and SIM status."
"[SMSForwarder] This is a test message from SMS Forwarder."
"Enter a 5–15 digit phone number, optionally prefixed with +."
"Message exceeds 10 parts. Sending stopped to limit charges."
"Hourly limit of 30 messages reached, including tests."
"Sending failed or the outcome is uncertain. No automatic retry."
"Some or all parts failed: %1$s (code %2$d). No automatic retry."
"Some or all parts failed delivery (code %1$d). No automatic retry."
"Duplicate message or hourly forwarding limit reached"
"Previous outcome could not be confirmed. No automatic retry."
"Required permissions are missing. Forwarding and tests cannot run. Grant SMS and phone permissions in app settings if the permission dialog no longer appears."
"Submitted %1$d message parts. Check carrier reports and the destination phone."
"Mobile radio is off; check airplane mode"
"Fixed dialing does not allow this number"
